reason: The 'no effect' conclusion rests on an unjustified restriction to the north subsample (N=634), which is the weakest region. With the same controls, the full sample (N=2000) gives 0.69 (SE 0.24, p=0.004) and the south gives 1.11 (p=0.01), so the estimate is a small positive effect. A null from a hand-picked, underpowered subgroup does not show absence of an effect.
